title: Course Ledger — courses configuration
description: Single source of truth for the courses in the site. Add or edit an entry here to add/rename a course; then drop the source PDFs in Documents/<dir>/ and run `npm run extract`.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier, e.g. `applied-ai`. Used in routes and validated server-side.

shortTitle.description: Compact title for nav and cards.

dir.description: Source folder name under `Documents/` holding this course's PDFs.

blurb.description: One-line standfirst shown on the section front.
